title: TimelineEvent
description: One event in a simulated match timeline. The envelope is stable (t, type, payload); the payload shape depends on type. See docs/02-data-model.md for per-type payload fields. Events are emitted in non-decreasing t order.

t.description: Game time in seconds (0 = match start). Ticks are 30s.

type.description: Event kind. Drives the payload shape and how the viewer renders/narrates it.

payload.description: Type-specific fields (documented per-type in docs/02-data-model.md). Kept as a plain JSON object so timelines diff cleanly and stay portable.
